answer.reason: The verses tell of Abiram's defiance of Moses and his being swallowed by the earth, which go beyond the summary's relations and tribe.

clauses.english: refused to come when Moses called him
was swallowed up by the earth with his household and Korah's company
clauses.quote: the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households

doubts: NUM 16:1 only names him among the rebels, so it is left out as a separate clause; NUM 16:24-25 and 27 are also left uncited as they add only the scene before the judgment.
The rebellion itself is covered by the disambiguator, so only his refusal and his end are given.
